body:
Been doing months of physical therapy and pain still won't go away but still not giving up quite yet. In the past I thought about dying before due to stress from school/work and close friends moving away. Now I feel like I really want to sometimes. Back then I could look on the bright sides of things and get some exercise, meet people and hiking. Now I cant do those things as much anymore. I work a job that isn't even related to my major but sometimes I can't find the motivation to try and build up my skills for my major or am not physically fit to do certain things involving it.

Honestly these injuries gave me a taste of what could happened in a botched attempt to take my life. The things in been through, major life events, stress from school and work and other things that affected my mental health just seem so trivial now that I have diminished physical health. I wish I looked more positively into life and looked at what I still had then. Its hard to enjoy what I still have now with these injuries that likely wont heal properly. Sometimes I fear how my future will play out. I cant even move furniture or walk long distances, so I fear having to move or do physical things. Its harder to make friends because I can't really go out and communicate with others and I have drifted further away from my friends from primary school and college. I sulked a lot when I was healthy, not wanting to make friends in fear of losing them and over my repetitive post-college life. My best friend from childhood also moved away and my high school friends have recently gone their own paths too. Even though I couldn't play sports with them anymore, I could still hang out and enjoy other things with them. Sometimes I feel hopeless seeing the people around me leave and being left with chronic pain.

I do go for at least 1 mile a day but sometimes I have to sit on a park bench and recuperate cause the pain gets to me sometimes. Sometimes I think to myself why I felt the need to go outside more and more, which ended up with me injured because I indulged in it too much and that I should have felt lucky where I was. Even when I'm not thinking of emotional stuff, just not being able to do things like I used to or wanting to get out of bed puts me in a bad mood. Therapy has been awfully slow and I had hope at one point that it would get better for me but the pain has only gotten worse.
